no_claim_on_file.title: No Claim on File
onCallAnalysis: When getting the status as no claim on file, always check the clearinghouse whether the claim was sent to insurance or it is rejected, if it is rejected then work as per the rejection.

There could be more than one CPTs billed on the same DOS or two DOS could be billed in a single claim form, so always open the claim form and provide the DOS range and total billed amount as mentioned in the claim form.
importantNotesAndActions: If the patient policy is active on DOS and DOS lies within TFL and the payer ID & mailing address are the same as the system details then you can resubmit the claim.

claim_in_process.title: Claim in Process
onCallAnalysis: Claim has been received cleanly by the clearinghouse/payer but is still undergoing standard adjudication cycles.
importantNotesAndActions: Verify the standard processing turnaround timeframe for the specific payer.
